rules: Network and paid inference require separate explicit user authorization.
Do not use locked labels to select weights or fix query prompts.
Each arm shares model, system prompt, native tools and task budget.
Compare stock zvec as a system; claim dense-only effect only on aligned representations.
Repeats are averaged within tasks, then analyzed by corpus clusters.

questions.product_increment: native (control) vs improved A2 (product), scripts/evaluate-java-task.mjs --arms product,control; paired kit comparison via scripts/eval-pilot-compare.mjs
questions.dense_mechanism_retrieval: A2 lexical top-K vs A3 RRF(lexical, dense) top-K, plus the non-semantic control a2-seeded-fill (driver removed after NO_GO; history at a2-static-fixes.md / commit d157b58)
questions.dense_mechanism_agent: same model/prompt/tools/budget; candidate block lexical top-K vs RRF top-K (driver removed after NO_GO; commit d157b58)

r11_protocol.renderer: declaration-head-window/v1: declaration start, floor(max_lines/max_regions) lines, clipped to the remaining task budget; stale files dropped

budget.source: task budget (all dev tasks share it)

r11_protocol.scorer: frozen kit harness/scoring.py (harness score/compare; scoreWithFrozenKit for agent QA); repair: frozen judge
r11_protocol.decision: decideFourWay/v2: GO_OPTIONAL needs Recall@10 delta >= gates.dense_recall_at_10_min_delta with lower bound > 0 over >= 8 clusters, A3 beating the seeded-fill control (lower > 0), MRR and line-recall lower bounds >= 0, agent QA lower bound >= 0 and prompt-token median ratio <= gates.dense_input_token_median_max_ratio; NO_GO when the Recall@10 upper bound < gate over >= 8 clusters; else INCONCLUSIVE; invalid/over-budget rows -> INVALID_EXPERIMENT
r11_protocol.zvec: not run: a native zvec system profile would be a separate system-level comparison, never mixed with this same-representation ablation
r11_protocol.eval_protocol: eval-protocol/v1.2 (scripts/evaluate-java-task.mjs EVAL_PROTOCOL_VERSION): per-round received-source ledger for both arms (QA), 80-line default read window, java_symbol head previews and no_vocabulary_overlap diagnosis
r11_protocol.retrieval_variants: all (kit primary + language variants), stratified by variant
r11_protocol.follow_up: docs/next-stage/a2-static-fixes.md (retrieval dense decision NO_GO under v1.2 with name locators)
r11_protocol.dense_closed: dense experiment closed: drivers and the product search_doc_text table (index schema v8) removed, schema v9; experiments/semantic-discovery keeps only provider.mjs and repair-judge.mjs, which the frozen audit imports by path
r11_protocol.evidence_pilot: docs/next-stage/a2-evidence-pilot.md (eval-protocol/v1.3: declaration ranges, preview-is-not-evidence guidance; REVERT by the pre-registered token guard)
